headline: Meta is reportedly ready to launch less pervy smart glasses
summary: Meta may launch camera-free smart glasses, codenamed Luna. This aims to address privacy concerns. It follows PR issues with previous video-recording models.

headline: The Boox Palma 3 gets stylus support and a sleek redesign
summary: The Boox Palma 3 e-reader is updated with a sleek redesign. It now features stylus support and new functionalities. The new model comes with a notable price increase.

headline: The EOS R8 Mark II is Canon’s lightest full-frame camera with stabilization
summary: Canon announced the EOS R8 Mark II, its lightest full-frame camera. It now includes in-body stabilization, a key upgrade. The camera boasts a new retro-inspired redesign.

headline: AI and data centers are incredibly unpopular in every poll
summary: New poll data reveals AI and data centers are highly unpopular. 61% of voters oppose building data centers for AI. This reflects growing public and political concern.

headline: Will Microsoft Kill Day 1 Launches via Game Pass? After Word Leaks of Potential Changes, Xbox Says It Has Nothing 'To Announce Today'
summary: A leak suggests Microsoft might end Day 1 game releases on Game Pass. Xbox states no changes are 'finalized' today. This potential shift could significantly impact subscribers.

headline: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Developers Explain Why You Only Need 1 Save File — and That The Game Originally Had 8 Protagonists
summary: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave developers discussed design choices. They explained the decision for only one save file. The game originally featured eight protagonists.

headline: PS5 Update Lets You Turn on Display Names, Adds Trending Now and Top 10 Views, and More
summary: A new PS5 system software update has been released. It adds options for display names and 'Trending Now' features. The update also includes other user-facing changes.

headline: Trails In The Sky 2nd Chapter Review
summary: The 'Trails In The Sky 2nd Chapter' review is out. It's lauded as an impressive remake. The game successfully captures the original's endearing qualities.

headline: Petrol and diesel price rises push UK inflation higher
summary: UK inflation increased due to rising petrol and diesel prices. Summer holidays contributed to this price growth. Middle East conflict disrupted global oil supplies.

headline: Support acts quit Ed Sheeran tour after Macklemore dropped over pro-Palestine comments
summary: Support acts left Ed Sheeran's tour. This follows Macklemore's removal after pro-Palestine statements. Sheeran denies responsibility for Macklemore being dropped.

headline: EU chief opens door for Canada to become 'associate member'
summary: The EU chief offered Canada 'associate member' status. Canada is seeking closer ties with the EU. This follows strained relations with the US under Trump.

headline: At least 20 killed and dozens missing after war-damaged Gaza building collapses
summary: A war-damaged building in Gaza City collapsed. At least 20 people have been confirmed killed. Dozens more are missing beneath the rubble.
